newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-AUTHORITY STARTS SPONSORSHIP DEAL ON PAY-BACK BASIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AUTHORITY STARTS SPONSORSHIP DEAL ON PAY-BACK BASIS.

text.p: The Catalan Tennis Federation has reached agreement to sponsor five promising young players on the condition that they pay back the money if they make the top 100 in the world rankings.

"We believe that the agreement is favourable for both sides," said Federation manager Albert Espanol, whose organisation will spend 100 million pesetas ($787,000) over four years on equipment, travel and coaching for the players.
The Catalonia region of Spain, which includes the city of Barcelona, has produced the best Spanish players of recent years, amongst them Sergi Bruguera and Arantxa Sanchez Vicario.
